spectrum: p.eyebrow:Design system,h2:Spectrum foundations,p:Color, typography, and layout for coherent product experiences.,div.detail-body(section(h3:Color,p:Semantic tokens map every surface, border, and text colour to a role rather than a fixed value, so the same component reads correctly in light and dark themes.),section(h3:Typography,p:A single type ramp drives headings, body copy, and captions. Sizes step on a consistent scale so density can change without redrawing the hierarchy.),section(h3:Layout,p:Spacing tokens keep rhythm predictable across breakpoints. Components claim space from the same scale, which keeps unrelated screens feeling related.)),p.detail-footer:Bottom of the Spectrum foundations page
workflow: p.eyebrow:Interaction,h2:Workflow patterns,p:Predictable controls and feedback for focused creative work.,div.detail-body(section(h3:Controls,p:Every control states what it will do before it is pressed and confirms what happened afterwards, so a long editing session never depends on memory.),section(h3:Feedback,p:Progress, success, and failure share one vocabulary. A slow operation reports itself the same way whether it takes a moment or several minutes.),section(h3:Recovery,p:Destructive actions are reversible wherever possible, and where they are not, the confirmation names the exact thing about to be lost.)),p.detail-footer:Bottom of the Workflow patterns page
content: p.eyebrow:Presentation,h2:Content surfaces,p:Responsive structures that preserve hierarchy across devices.,div.detail-body(section(h3:Structure,p:Content is grouped before it is styled. The reading order in the markup matches the visual order, which keeps assistive technology in step with sighted use.),section(h3:Density,p:The same content adapts from a wide desktop canvas to a narrow phone column by dropping decoration first and never dropping meaning.),section(h3:Media,p:Images and video sit inside the layout grid rather than breaking it, so a page keeps its shape while assets stream in at different rates.)),p.detail-footer:Bottom of the Content surfaces page
layers: p.eyebrow:Structure,h2:Layer model,p:Elevation, overlays, and stacking that never trap the reader.,div.detail-body(section(h3:Elevation,p:Each layer earns its shadow from how far it sits above the page, so depth reads as hierarchy rather than decoration.),section(h3:Overlays,p:An overlay owns focus for as long as it is open and hands it straight back to whatever opened it when it closes.),section(h3:Stacking,p:Stacking contexts are declared in one place, so a new surface cannot quietly slide underneath an existing one.)),p.detail-footer:Bottom of the Layer model page
motion: p.eyebrow:Animation,h2:Motion principles,p:Movement that explains where a thing came from and went.,div.detail-body(section(h3:Continuity,p:An element that becomes another element moves there rather than being replaced, so the relationship survives the change.),section(h3:Duration,p:Short distances finish quickly and long ones take longer, which keeps perceived speed constant across screen sizes.),section(h3:Restraint,p:Motion carries meaning or it is removed, and every motion has a reduced-motion equivalent that says the same thing.)),p.detail-footer:Bottom of the Motion principles page
tokens: p.eyebrow:Foundations,h2:Design tokens,p:One source of truth shared by design tools and code.,div.detail-body(section(h3:Naming,p:A token names the role it plays, not the value it holds, so the value can change without a rename rippling through the product.),section(h3:Layers,p:Global tokens feed component tokens, and only the component layer is consumed directly, which keeps overrides local.),section(h3:Delivery,p:The same token set is published for CSS, native platforms, and design tools from one build, so no platform drifts.)),p.detail-footer:Bottom of the Design tokens page
accessibility: p.eyebrow:Inclusion,h2:Accessible by default,p:Keyboard, focus, and assistive technology as first-class paths.,div.detail-body(section(h3:Keyboard,p:Every action is reachable with a keyboard, in an order that matches the visual layout without a single tab trap.),section(h3:Focus,p:Focus is always visible and always somewhere sensible, including immediately after a surface opens or closes.),section(h3:Semantics,p:Roles and names come from real elements wherever possible, so assistive technology reads the page without a parallel description.)),p.detail-footer:Bottom of the Accessible by default page
typography: p.eyebrow:Foundations,h2:Type scale,p:One ramp driving headings, body copy, and captions.,div.detail-body(section(h3:Ramp,p:Sizes step on a fixed ratio, so a heading two levels up is recognisable as such without measuring it.),section(h3:Rhythm,p:Line height is derived from size rather than chosen per block, which keeps paragraphs aligned across columns.),section(h3:Density,p:The ramp shifts as a whole between comfortable and compact, so hierarchy survives a change of density.)),p.detail-footer:Bottom of the Type scale page
iconography: p.eyebrow:Assets,h2:Iconography,p:A drawn vocabulary that stays legible at every size.,div.detail-body(section(h3:Grid,p:Icons are drawn on a shared grid with a shared stroke weight, so a row of them reads as one set rather than a collection.),section(h3:Sizes,p:Each icon is drawn at the sizes it ships in rather than scaled, because a scaled stroke thins out and loses its shape.),section(h3:Meaning,p:An icon never carries meaning alone: it labels an action that is also named, or it is marked decorative.)),p.detail-footer:Bottom of the Iconography page
data-viz: p.eyebrow:Analysis,h2:Data visualization,p:Charts that answer a question before they decorate a page.,div.detail-body(section(h3:Encoding,p:Position carries the primary comparison, with colour and size reserved for the dimensions that tolerate less precision.),section(h3:Palettes,p:Categorical, sequential, and diverging palettes are distinct sets, and none of them relies on hue alone to separate series.),section(h3:Honesty,p:Axes state their baseline and their units, so a chart cannot exaggerate a difference by cropping it.)),p.detail-footer:Bottom of the Data visualization page
forms: p.eyebrow:Input,h2:Form patterns,p:Fields, validation, and errors that respect the reader.,div.detail-body(section(h3:Labels,p:Every field has a persistent label, because a placeholder disappears exactly when it is most needed.),section(h3:Validation,p:Errors arrive when the reader has finished, name the field, and say what would be accepted instead.),section(h3:Progress,p:Long forms save as they go and say what is left, so leaving the page never means starting again.)),p.detail-footer:Bottom of the Form patterns page
navigation: p.eyebrow:Structure,h2:Navigation shells,p:Ways in and out that stay oriented at every width.,div.detail-body(section(h3:Orientation,p:The shell always states where the reader is, so a deep link lands somewhere that explains itself.),section(h3:Adaptation,p:A rail becomes a drawer becomes a bar as width runs out, and the same destinations survive each change.),section(h3:History,p:Back does what the reader expects because navigation is real navigation, not state hidden inside a component.)),p.detail-footer:Bottom of the Navigation shells page
theming: p.eyebrow:Appearance,h2:Theming,p:Light, dark, and contrast from one set of decisions.,div.detail-body(section(h3:Roles,p:Surfaces, borders, and text take their colour from a role, so swapping a theme never asks a component to be rewritten.),section(h3:Contrast,p:Every pairing is checked against its own background, and the high-contrast theme is a supported theme rather than a filter.),section(h3:Scoping,p:A theme applies to a subtree, so a preview can show one appearance inside a page rendered in another.)),p.detail-footer:Bottom of the Theming page
performance: p.eyebrow:Engineering,h2:Performance budgets,p:Limits agreed up front rather than measured after release.,div.detail-body(section(h3:Budgets,p:Bytes, frames, and interaction latency each get a number, and a change that exceeds one is a decision rather than a surprise.),section(h3:Measurement,p:The numbers come from the devices the product is actually used on, not from the machine the code was written on.),section(h3:Regression,p:Budgets are asserted in continuous integration, so drift fails a named check instead of accumulating quietly.)),p.detail-footer:Bottom of the Performance budgets page
localization: p.eyebrow:Reach,h2:Localization,p:Layouts that survive translation and mirroring.,div.detail-body(section(h3:Length,p:Space is reserved for text that grows by a third under translation, so a label wraps rather than overflowing its control.),section(h3:Direction,p:Layout uses logical properties throughout, so a right-to-left locale mirrors without a second stylesheet.),section(h3:Formats,p:Dates, numbers, and names are formatted by locale rather than assembled from fragments that only read correctly in one.)),p.detail-footer:Bottom of the Localization page
testing: p.eyebrow:Quality,h2:Testing surfaces,p:Hooks that make behaviour observable without pinning pixels.,div.detail-body(section(h3:Contracts,p:Components publish the state a test needs to read, so a test asserts behaviour rather than scraping a class name.),section(h3:Layers,p:Pure logic is tested as pure logic, interaction in a real browser, and appearance by screenshot — each at the cheapest layer that can see the failure.),section(h3:Determinism,p:Clocks, randomness, and network calls are injectable, so a failing test fails again for the same reason.)),p.detail-footer:Bottom of the Testing surfaces page
